name: Sankore Madrasah
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: Sankoré Madrasa (also called the Sankoré Mosque, Sankoré Masjid, Sankoré Madrasah or University of Sankoré) is one of three medieval mosques and centres of learning located in Timbuktu, Mali. (The others being Djinguereber and Sidi Yahya) Founded in the 14th or early 15th century, the Sankoré mosque went through multiple periods of patronage and renovation under both the Mali Empire and the Songhai Empire until its decline following the Battle of Tondibi in 1591. The mosque developed into an Arabian madrasa.

depictions.name: Sankore Madrasah
depictions.text: The Sankore Madrasah is an unconstructible building in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. The Sankore Madrasah has exactly the same stats and appearance as a Wonder, but does nothing in-game and is only available in the Scenario Editor.
